# Psalm 55 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 55:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. With-stringed-instruments. A-Maskil of-David.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. To be accompanied by stringed instruments. A psalm of David.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **LOGOS:** Give ear to my prayer, O God, and hide not Yourself from my plea for mercy!
- **PNEUMA:** Listen to my prayer, O God. Do not ignore my cry for help!

## 55:4 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** because-of the-voice of-the-enemy, because-of the-oppression of-the-wicked; for they-cast iniquity upon-me, and-in-anger they-bear-a-grudge against-me.
- **LOGOS:** because of the noise of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they drop trouble upon me, and in anger they bear a grudge against me.
- **PNEUMA:** My enemies shout at me, making loud and wicked threats. They bring trouble on me and angrily hunt me down.

- **PNEUMA:** My heart pounds in my chest. The terror of death assaults me.

## 55:8 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Behold, I-would-wander far-away; I-would-lodge in-the-wilderness. Selah.
- **LOGOS:** yes, I would wander far away; I would lodge in the wilderness; Selah
